### 4. Document and Data Processing

Many companies still manually transfer information between PDFs, spreadsheets, emails, invoices and business applications.

AI-powered document processing can help extract and classify information from documents and move relevant data into other systems.

This can be particularly useful for businesses handling large numbers of invoices, purchase orders, forms or customer documents.

### 5. HR and Recruitment

AI automation can support HR teams with repetitive administrative processes.

Possible applications include organizing applications, scheduling interviews, answering common employee questions, preparing onboarding workflows and generating routine HR reports. [...] Consider processes such as:

   ✓Purchase requests
   ✓Approval workflows
   ✓Employee onboarding
   ✓IT support requests
   ✓Contract reminders
   ✓Task assignments
   ✓Management notifications
   ✓Recurring reports

Connecting these processes through automation can reduce repetitive administrative work and make responsibilities easier to track.

### Where Should Your Business Start?

The best AI automation project does not always need to be the largest one.

Start by identifying a process that is:

   ✓Repetitive
   ✓Time-consuming
   ✓Rule-based
   ✓Performed frequently
   ✓Dependent on moving information between people or systems

Then determine what should be automated, what still requires human approval and how success will be measured. [...] AI automation can help businesses organize incoming leads, identify important information, prioritize opportunities and trigger follow-up workflows.

The objective is not necessarily to replace the salesperson. Instead, automation can reduce administrative work so the sales team can spend more time selling.
